answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the fable of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A terrace of per-task receipts records who did what, and the bridge of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, unlocked only after continuous uptime, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
